name: SNO+
summary: SNO+ repurposes the SNO infrastructure at SNOLAB with liquid scintillator for a broad neutrino programme and a planned tellurium-loaded double-beta-decay phase. Its depth supports low-background solar, reactor and geoneutrino measurements.
detection_principle: Scintillation photons measure low-energy interactions; prompt/delayed inverse-beta coincidences tag antineutrinos. Early operation used pure water and then unloaded scintillator. Tellurium loading is a separate phase aimed at neutrinoless double-beta decay.

results.summary: The NuPhys2026 contribution reported a Western-Hemisphere geoneutrino flux of 49 +13/-12 TNU and a reactor-oscillation mass-splitting measurement from 685 live days.
